It incorrectly identified "Mickey's Safari in Letterland" as being part of "Richard Scarry's Learning Games" and claimed the game features Mickey Mouse based on Scarry's illustrations. In reality, "Mickey's Safari in Letterland" is a 1993 educational video game starring Disney's Mickey Mouse, developed by Hi-Tech Expressions and published by Playtronic. It is not part of Richard Scarry's Busytown series. The Planner hallucinated a connection between the game and Richard Scarry, leading to the completely wrong final answer (Richard Scarry instead of Walt Disney, who created Mickey Mouse).
